format_python_code: format Python code using Black by sending code to the /code/format endpoint
execute_python_code: execute Python code via Jupyter engine through the /code/execute endpoint
convert_markdown_to_html: convert Markdown text to HTML using the /markdown endpoint
export_chat_as_pdf: export a chat conversation with title and messages as a downloadable PDF via the /pdf endpoint
download_database: download the SQLite database file as an admin via the /db/download endpoint
